ideas.title: NY pre-market opposite-side liquidity
ideas.observation: After one side of the 07:00-09:00 New York pre-market range is taken during or around the opening process, subsequent movement may target liquidity at the opposite side.
ideas.notes: Recorded from visual feature validation only; this is not a V0.2 strategy rule.
